product.name: Acute
product.tagline: Local-first multi-agent engineering workbench — sandboxed file tools, streaming chat, sub-agent orchestration, approvals, and an embedded browser on a single desktop.

pillars.title: Coding pillar
pillars.summary: Streaming chat with tool calls, project indexing, command palette (⌘K), approvals engine, notifications, web tools — daily-driver quality on a real codebase.

pillars.title: Agentic system pillar
pillars.summary: Sub-agent multi-turn delegation (delegate_task), live forwarding, per-session state, atomic slot reservation, key pools, retry-from-event-log recovery. Full orchestration engine gated on Phase 3.

pillars.title: Automation pillar
pillars.summary: Scheduling, visual workflows, and the event bus — researched in docs/research/n8n; not yet implemented.

current.title: R41 — Dashboard overhaul + embedded Chromium browser + per-session sidebar state
current.detail: Public dashboard rebuilt with a highly-detailed design, dark mode, and dedicated Features + Documentation sections. Inside the app: a full-fledged embedded Chromium browser, dedicated collapse section in the right sidebar, popover bounds, per-session sidebar state, and desktop notifications. Verify pipeline stays green (243 tests).

upcoming.note: Multi-agent run loop, shared message bus, Kanban task board, three run modes (single / auto-team / manual).
Visual canvas, cron-style scheduling, event bus (n8n-pattern reference).
License-audit the Tauri/Rust sidecar dependencies alongside the existing pnpm audit.

principles: Local-first — all processing on-device; LLMs are the only cloud hop
Additive architecture — no rewrites, every round layers on top of the prior
Quality over speed — every round is lint + typecheck + test + build + license-audit green
Approval-gated — the human approval engine IS the security boundary in v1
Documentation is a deliverable — ADRs, runbooks, and round-notes are required, not optional

features.title: Embedded browser
features.desc: Right-sidebar Chromium panel with click-to-open navigation, custom user-agent, and full DOM access for agent-driven browsing.

features.title: Right-sidebar tabs
features.desc: File viewer · Browser · Terminal · Sub-agents — a browser-style tab strip with per-session state and bounds-safe popovers.

features.title: Notifications + SSE
features.desc: Notification center with bell + unread badge, server-sent events stream, and optional desktop notifications for completed turns and approvals.

features.title: Sub-agent live streaming
features.desc: Multi-turn delegate_task with per-child sessions, live forwarded tokens, retry-from-event-log recovery, and atomic concurrency-slot reservation.

features.title: Approvals engine v1
features.desc: Layered policy (blocked → destructive → safelist → confirm), interactive Allow once / Always allow / Deny, 120 s fail-closed timeout, denylist-supreme compound-command guard.

features.title: Command palette ⌘K
features.desc: Symbol-search and file-open via Ctrl/Cmd-K with grep options (case-sensitive, whole-word, file glob, max results).

features.title: Project indexing
features.desc: codebase_index table + index_project tool — 318 files / 2 384 symbols indexed in 124 ms on the demo battery; CODEBASE AWARENESS prompt injection.

features.title: Web tools (web_fetch + web_search)
features.desc: Kilo/Cline-parity web tools — read a page, search the web, feed results back as tool_results for multi-step reasoning.

features.title: Streaming chat
features.desc: SSE text deltas + interleaved tool calls + thinking blocks + per-reply usage stats (ms / in / out / tok / s).
